scenes.heading: Types of machine learning
scenes.caption: Machine learning builds a function from examples instead of writing every rule by hand. You show inputs and the answers you wanted. A training process searches for a function that would have produced those answers. It is the right tool when you cannot write the rule, and the wrong tool when a clear rule already exists.
